vb_textbox.text: The colour of the gnomes doesn't seem to impact the amount of mushrooms you get. It seems to be a momentum based thing in that sometimes the bigger gnomes will give more whilst others the smaller ones will. If you find that the bigger ones are giving at least 5 mushrooms, keep choosing them. Once this number drops below 5 or 6, switch to picking the smaller gnomes and repeat the process. You should get pretty good levels of mushrooms each time.
